719-3510-3875-6705.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Xenograft.
719-3510-3875-6705.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Xenograft and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Provisioner to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Quina.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

643-5411-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-5411-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability, giving a creature haste until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

512-4137-4644.easyPrerequisites: Blossom-Clad Werewolf and Tidewater Minion do not have summoning sickness.
512-4137-4644.description:
Activate Blossom-Clad Werewolf by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Tidewater Minion and Blossom-Clad Werewolf, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Tidewater Minion ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3259-5434-8139.easyPrerequisites: Scepter of Celebration is attached to a creature you control other than the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
3259-5434-8139.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5434-8139.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and the creature that has Scepter of Celebration attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Scepter of Celebration.
Resolve the Scepter of Celebration trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

465-585-3742-4251-6633.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Phantom Steed to become a Samurai until end of turn.
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping it and all Samurai you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

240-1849-5470-8095.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat from step 2.

1978-3980-5793-7008.description:
Activate Sisay's Ring by tapping it, adding two mana.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sisay's Ring which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

215-527-4927.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
215-527-4927.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1368-6006-6321-6633.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-6006-6321-6633.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1524-5256-5659-5929.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ilharg.
When Ilharg dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Ilharg's power, which will cause you to mill Ilharg.
As Ilharg is a Lhurgoyf due to Leyline of Transformation, Disa's first ability triggers, returning Ilharg from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1636-5914-7489.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with greater mana value than Matterbending Mage that can be cast using only mana creatures you control can produce.
1636-5914-7489.description:
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Matterbending Mage.
Cast Matterbending Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Matterbending Mage enters the battlefield, it, Clement and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Clement trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Matterbending Mage trigger, returning the other creature with greater mana value from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast the creature returned to your hand.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Clement and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Clement trigger, returning Matterbending Mage from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-5914-7489.notes: You can tap Frogs for mana thanks to Clement. This should be factored in when determining if you have enough mana to execute the combo.

4929-5224-7430.notablePrerequisites: You've had a creature under your control this turn.
4929-5224-7430.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {0}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Gorma.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Cryptic Trilobite dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Together Forever and Gorma.
Resolve the Together Forever trigger, returning Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Gorma trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

140-6736-7433.description:
Activate Marrow Bats by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast a copy of Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

5686-7124-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
5686-7124-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
5686-7124-7358.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a 1/1 Devil creature token.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Devil.
When the Devil dies, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat each combat phase.

437-509-2751-4131-5776.description:
Cast Idris by paying its mana cost.
When Idris enters the battlefield, its imprint ability triggers, targeting Sphinx's Disciple.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Idris' trigger, targeting Basalt Monolith.
Resolve both Idris triggers, exiling Basalt Monolith and Sphinx's Disciple.
During your next turn, activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 5.

2034-4679-6023-7220.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Glamermite.
When the Glamermite token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Glamermite token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1402-1477-3593-4359.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Diamond Lion from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Diamond Lion by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Garna.
Resolve the Garna ability from step 3, returning all creature cards that were put in your graveyard this turn to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2034-3330-3490-4017.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3330-3490-4017.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

394-2034-3000-5220-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
394-2034-3000-5220-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

2511-3661-5220-6900.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

656-5220-6247.description:
Cast Ugin's Conjurant by paying {0}.
Ugin's Conjurant enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and High-Society Hunter.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Ugin's Conjurant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the High-Society Hunter trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Ugin's Conjurant from your library.
Repeat.

3090-5571-6798--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 2.

647-1563-2457-3000.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1491-5268-6218-6627.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2167-3534-5626-5721.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You have at least {E}{E}.
You control at least six mana-producing lands, one of which can tap to produce at least {B} and another of which can tap to produce at least {G}.
2167-3534-5626-5721.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land, adding one mana of any color that land could produce.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least {4}{B}{G} available and/or you control no other mana-producing lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Field of the Dead triggers that many times, creating that many creature tokens.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}, sacrificing a creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

2034-4871-6115.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ozox, adding {C}{C}.
When Ozox dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Ozox trigger, creating a legendary 2/1 Jumblebones creature token.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jumblebones, adding {C}{C}.
When Jumblebones dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Jumblebones trigger, returning Ozox from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Ozox by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

2061-3663-4772.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating two token copies of Three Blind Mice.
The Three Blind Mice tokens enter the battlefield with two lore counters on them due to Doubling Season, triggering their first and second chapter abilities.
Resolve the first Three Blind Mice triggers, creating four 1/1 Mouse creature tokens.
Resolve the next Three Blind Mice trigger, creating two token copies of a Three Blind Mice token.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite Three Blind Mice triggers, you may use them to copy any token(s) you control.

1167-2928-4502.description:
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain control of target player during their next turn.
During the opponent's turn, cast Game of Chaos by paying {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve Game of Chaos, choosing to continue flipping a coin until the opponent loses the flip and the amount of life wagered is greater than or equal to the opponent's life total.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

2456-4929-5224.notablePrerequisites:
Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least two additional artifacts.
2456-4929-5224.description:
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Cryptic Trilobite dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Together Forever triggers, returning Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Cryptic Trilobite, choosing one for {X}, but paying {0} due to Tezerret.
Repeat.

4747-5090.notablePrerequisites:
Singing Bell Strike attached to Alena.
Alena does not have summoning sickness.
You have had a creature with power seven or greater enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
4747-5090.description:
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least seven {R}.
Activate Alena by paying {6}, untapping it.
Repeat.

851-1308-2557-3209.description:
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback for {4}{G}, creating eight 1/1 green Saproling token.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback, tapping five green 1/1 Saproling tokens to pay for it using convoke.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4385.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}, creating a 1/1 Sliver token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Sliver token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

225-3664-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
225-3664-4222.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.
